2226-2499-4518.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-4518.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4875-6495-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-6495-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-6495-6871-6879.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1894-2173-5220-7492.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1309-1987-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1309-1987-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-539-5704-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with power 4 or greater.
215-539-5704-7781.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Leafkin Avenger
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3398-7283-7651.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
Raphael is indestructible.
An opponent cannot block and kill Smaug or Hellkite Charger.
3398-7283-7651.description:
Declare Smaug and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, dealing at least 7 damage to Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding at least seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3398-7283-7651.notes: If you control more Treasures, you'll net additional {R} each loop, which won't be lost due to Raphael's effect. You can then redirect Smaug's damage to any desired target(s).

1478-3875-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Sakura-Tribe Elder's ability by sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food token
Repeat.

1912-2757-7132.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {W} due to Biomancer's Familiar, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Wall, untapping a basic Plains.
Repeat.

1171-1409-6968.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

628-6797-7195.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5295-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4552-4832.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

1796-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-5226-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-5226-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-5226-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

5413-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5413-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

969-1256-1270-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

413-1789-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
413-1789-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Blasting Station trigger.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3476-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

803-4050-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-4050-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-4050-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Snail, adding one mana of any color.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead sacrifce the Snails to Wick's ability.

2757-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
2757-5189-5641.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic land you control.
Repeat.

962-2816-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
962-2816-4893.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and untapping it, causing itself to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large amount of times.
It is strongly recommended to empty your mana pool using a mana sink before proceeding.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
Each player whose mana pool contained an amount of mana equal to or greater than their life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life, which causes a draw if every player lost the game.

2011-3973-4214.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least eight permanents of any one color on the battlefield.
An opponent cannot block Rith.
2011-3973-4214.description:
Declare Rith and Najeela, if desired, as attackers.
If one or more Warriors attack, Najeela triggers, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
 If there are at least nine permanents of any color on the battlefield and/or you control a Warrior that can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

2364-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2364-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

578-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
578-3263-3525.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least one artifact card from your hand, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

3560-3605-4050-4518.description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Dance of the Dead and Kor Skyfisher enter the battlefield, triggering Kor Skyfisher and Archon of Sun's Grace.
Resolve the Archon of Sun's Grace trigger, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from the battlefield to your hand.
Dance of the Dead leaves the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher and the Pegasus token, adding {1}{B}.
Resolve the Dance of the Dead trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Kor Skyfisher due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1908-1947-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Hellkite Charger does not have summoning sickness.
You have cast at least three instants and/or sorceries this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Hellkite Charger.
1908-1947-3398.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least four copies of Reckless Barbarian with haste.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate four Reckless Barbarian tokens by sacrificing them, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger ability, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

313-2034-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
313-2034-3821.description:
Activate up to fiva mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
Repeat.

1267-2034-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai in your graveyard.Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1267-2034-4897.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Medomai, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1646-4050-4831.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
1646-4050-4831.description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible by any method.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon and creating a 1/1 Squirrel token.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Acorn Catapult.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
